earned_by: BEYOND-CLASS2-20261027-001A proved that a graded hard pair across layers makes counting #P-hard; the open case is the four-way group, here realized as G = U4(F_p) x| <D>, D = diag(1, -1, 1, -1) at r = 2 (no graded hard pair; at r = 2 none can exist). Earlier scoping in the epic found the base four-way form zero on twist-knot sums at alpha = -1 and steering by cabled pure-braid insertions matching the Milnor tensor up to an isomorphism of the target. The theory for ticket C now predicts the form exactly: a J-duality (the Fox-coloring transport, Burau at t = -1, preserves the form J with 2 (-1)^(q - q') below the diagonal) turns layer-3 obstructions into a four-linear form Q(c; s) = <o(c), J^T s>; inserting the 2-cable of a pure braid with conjugators in the third lower central term changes Q by a constant times the Magnus tensor of the conjugators contracted with bundle functionals; sums of knots with one-dimensional twisted H^1 have Q = 0. This experiment tests those predictions exactly, on new primes, knots, a second pure braid, combined and dragged insertions, and the full gadget, with two independent measurement paths. Scoping disclosed in scoping/README.md: it fixed the constant kappa (2 in the braid model, -2 in the level model) on cabled P4 insertions on 4_1 x4 at p = 5 and ran gadgets K2, P3, the digon, K3 and the star at p = 5, 7 (all as predicted); those fixtures are rerun as regression.
question: Is the four-way form of S^3_2 of the gadget braids exactly the predicted sum of Magnus tensors of the inserted pure braids contracted with bundle functionals, with zero base, at p = 5, 7, 11, 13, for two different pure braids, combined and dragged insertions and six graphs; and do independent group-law counts confirm the count formula and the lifting criterion?

public_inputs.group: G = U4(F_p) x| <D>, D = diag(1, -1, 1, -1): superdiagonal (c_y, c_x, c_w) layer 1, entries (1,3), (2,4) layer 2, (1,4) layer 3; isomorphic for p >= 5 to bc_lib.four_way_algebra(p, 2, 1) with y = E12, x = E23, w = E34
public_inputs.manifolds: S^3_2(closure of a braid word); bases: connected sums of 4_1 and 5_2 (cp_lib.connected_sum) and of T(2, p) (closure of s1^p ... sN^p)
public_inputs.braids: P4 = [[A12, A23], A34] and P4B = [[A23, A34], A12] (mlib.py), inserted as gamma . cable(P, 2, offset) . gamma^-1 (cp_lib.cable)
public_inputs.gadget: fixtures.gadget: vertex v <-> strand v, edge e = (u, v): private strands b+1..b+6 (b = n + 6e), gamma drags strand v then strand u over to positions b, b - 1, insertion of cable(P4, 2, b - 1); base = sum of n + 6m copies of T(2, p)
public_inputs.fixtures: fixtures.py: BASES_LEVEL (9 bases, level model, full tables), BASES_BRAID (6 sums of T(2, p) at p = 5, 7, 11, 13), STEERING (17 insertion fixtures), STEERING_LEVEL (2 full-table fixtures), LIFT_FIXTURE, GRAPHS (6) x GADGET_PRIMES (5, 7, 11), COUNTS (4)
public_inputs.measurement: bm.py: closed-braid presentation, labels pushed through the braid as 4x4 matrices, layers 1 and 2 solved as linear systems, Q(c; s) = <o(c), (J^T s, 0)>; lp.py: level presentation with ticket A's Fox calculus, Q(c; s) = <o(c), (J s_{l+1}), 0>; bc_lib.direct_count: BCH four-way group on cp_lib's Wirtinger presentation (independent of bm.py, lp.py and mlib.py)

predictions.R0_base: Q = 0 identically on S^3_2 of sums of 4_1 (p = 5), 5_2 (p = 7) and T(2, p), every sample and every table entry
predictions.R1_steering: inserting gamma . cable(P, 2, o) . gamma^-1 at a level changes Q by kappa * sum_j Lam_j(c) ell_j(s), Lam_j(c) = sum M_j(i1 i2 i3) ell_i1(c_y) ell_i2(c_x) ell_i3(c_w), M_j the degree-3 Magnus part of the geometric conjugator W_j of P, ell_k = difference of the transported colors of bundle k at the middle level; insertions add; exact equality on every sample (braid model) and every table entry (level model, constant -kappa)
predictions.R2_gadget: on the gadget manifold of K2, P3, the digon, K3, K1,3 and C4 at p = 5, 7, 11: Q = kappa * sum over edges of the P4 tensor with leaf 0 = s_v - s_u and leaf k = s_{b+2k} - s_{b+2k-1} (top colors); the transported leaves equal these closed forms
predictions.R4_lifting: on 4_1 x4 + P4 (0,0) at p = 5, for 40 class triples (10 with c_y = 0, 10 with c_x = 0, 20 random), the independent group-law count with fixed layer-1 data is positive exactly when Q(c; .) = 0, and then equals p^(N+1) = 3125
predictions.dims: dim of the fixed colorings = number of summands + 1 on every fixture (dim H^1(M; F_p^-) = number of summands)

controls.machinery (any failure makes the run inv: M1 B^T J B = J for every letter, n <= 10, p in 5, 7, 11, 13; M2 (J^T s)_q + (J^T s)_{q+1} = -(s_{q+1} - s_q); M3 the 2-cable acts by substituting bundle products x_{2k+1} x_{2k} into the geometric conjugators, the conjugators lie in the third lower central term, and the cable's coloring transport is the identity, for P4 and P4B; M4 on every braid-model fixture the fixed colorings have dimension (summands + 1) and (J^T s, 0) annihilates the layer-3 linear part; M5 on every level-model base y(s) lies in the left kernel and dim H^1 = summands
controls.negative (each must show a mismatch, els: X1 gadget K3 at p = 5 predicted with one edge dropped; X2 gadget P3 at p = 5 with bundles 0 and 2 swapped; X3 4_1 x4 + P4 (0,0) with a random tensor of the same size; X4 the same with kappa = 1; X5 T(2,5) x8 without insertion predicted as if P4 were inserted at (0,1)

decision_rule: Invalid if a machinery check fails or a negative control matches. Supported if R0-R4 and the dimension prediction hold on every fixture. Refuted otherwise, naming every failed item; neither predictions nor construction change after this contract.
stop_rule: Run run.py once (machinery first); no adaptive extension.
seeds: numpy default_rng with fixed seeds per fixture (in run.py)
environment: workspace .venv python (numpy); cp_lib.py (COPRIME-CLASS2-20261026-001B) and bc_lib.py (BEYOND-CLASS2-20261027-001A) imported read-only
red_team_r0: Random samples test a four-linear identity at 64 points per fixture; a wrong form agreeing on all of them is unlikely but not excluded. Full tables (level model) cover two insertions and nine bases exactly.

The predictions use the transported colorings, which bm.py also uses as layer-1 data; the colors are inputs, not the object under test. The closed-form leaves of the gadget are checked against the transported ones.
The constant kappa was read off in scoping at p = 5 on P4; its value at other primes and for P4B is a test.
Gadgets up to 28 summands and 788 crossings test the construction, not every graph; the realization for all graphs is ticket C's proof.
The lifting test and the direct counts use an independent group model and presentation but only small fixtures.
nonclaims: No claim for p = 2, 3, for r > 2, or for knot exteriors.
forbidden_inputs: Measured forms as inputs to the predictions
Predicted values as inputs to the measurement
